_comment: PF1 creature types (#112). Each type's racial hit dice chassis: HD size, BAB progression, good saves, and skill ranks per HD. `traits` is prose the Defenses/Attributes tabs surface; nothing here is automated beyond hd/bab/saves/skills. Sources: PF1 Bestiary 'Creature Types' + the pf1 system's own creature-type table.

types.label: Animal
traits: Int 1 or 2 — no skill ranks in Int-based skills beyond its list

types.label: Construct
traits: Immune to mind-affecting, disease, death effects, necromancy, paralysis, poison, sleep, stunning
Not subject to nonlethal damage, ability damage/drain, fatigue, exhaustion, energy drain
Destroyed at 0 hp; cannot be raised or resurrected

types.label: Dragon
traits: Immune to magic sleep and paralysis

types.label: Ooze
traits: Immune to critical hits, flanking, gaze, illusions, poison, polymorph, sleep, stunning, visual effects

types.label: Outsider
traits: Cannot be raised or resurrected without wish/miracle

types.label: Plant
traits: Immune to mind-affecting, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep, stunning

types.label: Undead
traits: No Constitution score — uses Charisma for hit points
Immune to mind-affecting, disease, death effects, paralysis, poison, sleep, stunning
Not subject to nonlethal damage, ability drain, energy drain, fatigue, exhaustion
Destroyed at 0 hp; healed by negative energy, harmed by positive energy
